qualification: Recipe SQL seed delivery and bounded startup only; node IBD, pool and mining shares remain pending.

before:
set -eu
mkdir -p /data/ui/state /data/litecoin /data/dogecoin /data/pool/config /data/postgres
chown -R 1000:1000 /data/ui /data/litecoin /data/dogecoin /data/pool /data/pool/config || true
chown -R 70:70 /data/postgres || true
chmod 700 /data/postgres || true
after:
set -eu
test -d /data
test ! -L /data
test -d /data/postgres-init
test ! -L /data/postgres-init
test -f /data/postgres-init/2-schema.sql
test ! -L /data/postgres-init/2-schema.sql
test "$$(stat -c '%h' /data/postgres-init/2-schema.sql)" = 1
test "$$(stat -c '%s' /data/postgres-init/2-schema.sql)" -le 2097152
test -f /data/postgres-init/3-multi-pool-partition.sql
test ! -L /data/postgres-init/3-multi-pool-partition.sql
test "$$(stat -c '%h' /data/postgres-init/3-multi-pool-partition.sql)" = 1
test "$$(stat -c '%s' /data/postgres-init/3-multi-pool-partition.sql)" -le 2097152
printf '%s\n' 'c9a0e0c871ddb7fe198e154903c053db1a26c614c5062d660af0add0e2fc8427  /data/postgres-init/2-schema.sql' '83a380949be2a2dd7b67a667575fc06133eae7be885ce458e0687803edc2f4bf  /data/postgres-init/3-multi-pool-partition.sql' | sha256sum -c -
mkdir -p /data/ui/state /data/litecoin /data/dogecoin /data/pool/config /data/postgres
chown -R 1000:1000 /data/ui /data/litecoin /data/dogecoin /data/pool /data/pool/config || true
chown -R 70:70 /data/postgres || true
chmod 700 /data/postgres || true

ordinaryUmbrelDelivery.scope: Verify exact immutable template bytes; create only missing static SQL through no-follow descriptors and O_EXCL; preserve existing SQL and all database/wallet/config data. Init permissions rejects missing, unsafe or changed seeds before its existing filesystem operations.
